name: API Tester
description: HTTP and gRPC API testing workbench for DBX.
releaseNotes: Form and Multipart Form are now separate request body types sharing one text/file row editor: upload files directly, several per field name, streamed to the sidecar in chunks (1 GB per file, 5 GB total), with Content-Type and boundary generated when sending. Binary responses and Content-Disposition attachments download while they stream, unaffected by the display limit, with a real total size, a cancel action, and no save for non-2xx. A new Actual Request tab shows exactly what was sent; JSON bodies are validated before sending with line and column; text bodies default to charset=utf-8; binary responses render as a file card instead of base64.
